purpose: Physically validate the Computer Use P3A deterministic observation-to-target resolution boundary using a real P2B text-region interpretation and a single exact-text match, without authorizing or executing an input action.
requiredClaims: the real P1B mapped-frame path supplies the captured PNG
the real P2B provider-neutral contract normalizes local OCR observations
the real P3A product resolver selects exactly one text-region observation for an exact-text query
the resolved target uses the exact-text-single-match policy
the resolved target region center is mapped through the physically validated P1B transform into primary-display-logical coordinates
the resolved logical point falls inside the independently known test-owned target window
zero-match and multiple-match cases remain fail-closed in contract tests
no pointer, click, drag, wheel or keyboard action is performed
frame payload, recognized text and coordinates are not persisted or logged
fixture and Computer Control runtime are cleaned up
both product working trees remain clean
nonClaims: the visual target is not a semantic UI identity
no fuzzy, contains, ranked or model-based target matching is validated
no VLM/object/icon target resolution is validated
no target is authorized for action
no low-level action derived from the resolved target is executed
no arbitrary user-content OCR accuracy claim is made
event delivery is not equated with semantic task success

promotionOnPass.nextPhase: P3B target action-policy authorization boundary, followed by P4 action plus independent postcondition verification
